title: IMPRESS: Evaluating the Resilience of Imperceptible Perturbations Against Unauthorized Data Usage in Diffusion-Based Generative AI
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the technical evaluation of image protection methods for generative AI.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It introduces a platform named IMPRESS to evaluate the effectiveness of imperceptible perturbations in protecting images from unauthorized use by diffusion-based generative AI, such as style mimicry and malicious editing.
